observations: Bare PCB scan exposes through-hole footprints for both removed stick modules and multiple mounting holes.
Image is useful for planar landmark correspondence; it contains neither joystick gimbal geometry nor the front housing.
Silkscreen includes X913434-007; do not silently equate all 1708 board revisions.
metadata_caution: JPEG advertises 1200 dpi but is only 1024 pixels wide; editing/resizing history is not established. Do not convert pixels to millimeters using this tag.
reuse_scope: Reference image retained separately; no claim of open CAD licensing or permission to redistribute derived textures.

registration_attempt.settings: SIFT, exact BF L2 matching, tutorial ratio 0.7 and RANSAC threshold 5 px; seed 0. Unique destination matches; every third source-x-sorted match withheld before fitting. These are diagnostic algorithm settings, not mechanical tolerances.
registration_attempt.normal_result: results/pcb_registration_v1.json: 17 correspondences, 11 training, 6 held out, 6 training inliers; held-out median error 315.726 px
registration_attempt.mirror_result: results/pcb_registration_mirrored.json: only 7 correspondences, no fit attempted
registration_attempt.decision: Neither orientation supports a usable registration. Do not use the fitted normal-orientation matrix to transfer dimensions or joint coordinates. No calibration promoted.

manual_registration.fit: Four outer mounting holes; direct homography without robust rejection
manual_registration.held_out: Two inner holes and SW3 contact center, errors approximately 1.80, 5.97, 1.77 photo pixels
manual_registration.interpretation: Supports coarse planar layout correspondence, not exact board revision identity or metrology. Larger right-inner-hole error remains unresolved. No absolute scale or shaft height follows.

next_check: Review the larger right-inner-hole residual before finer transfers. Use only coplanar PCB features; shaft tops and rulers are on other planes. Do not transfer their coordinates as if on the PCB.
